lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Finance lease liabilities
lines.why: Leases that work like a loan for the asset: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: For the fiscal year ended January 3, 2026, approximately 9.1% of the Company’s revenue was generated outside the United States.
During the fiscal year ended January 3, 2026, the Company had two customers exceed 10% of consolidated revenue, representing 20.8% and 13.6% of consolidated revenue.
The Company’s five, ten and twenty largest customers accounted for approximately 51.0%, 64.9% and 75.0%, respectively, of the Company’s revenue for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2026.

Fixed‑price contract revenue recognized for the year ended January 3, 2026 was $73.2 million, representing approximately 23% of the Company’s revenue.
During the fiscal year ended January 3, 2026, the Company had two customers exceed 10% of consolidated revenue, representing 20.8 % and 13.6 % of consolidated revenue, respectively.
During the fiscal year ended December 28, 2024, the Company had two customers exceed 10% of consolidated revenue, representing 19.5 % and 14.1 % of consolidated revenue, respectively.
All customers exceeding 10% of consolidated revenue during the periods presented are included in the Company’s Specialty Health Care segment.
The Company’s five , ten and twenty largest customers accounted for approximately 48.5 %, 60.1 % and 70.6 %, respectively, of the Company’s revenue for the fiscal year ended December 28, 2024.
The Company’s operations depend on the continued efforts of its officers and other executive management.
The Company also depends on the performance and productivity of its local managers and field personnel.

The Company’s success depends on its ability to obtain and maintain its intellectual property, prevent its misappropriation or infringement, maintain trade secret protection, and conduct operations without violating or infringing on the intellectual property rights of third parties.

The Company is committed to optimizing its business model as a single-source premier provider of business and technology solutions with a strong vertical focus, offering an integrated suite of services through a global delivery platform.
The Company experiences volatility in its daily cash flow and, at times, relies on the revolving line of credit to provide daily liquidity for the Company’s financial operations.

The purchase plan permits eligible employees to purchase shares of common stock through payroll deductions for up to 10 % of qualified compensation, subject to maximum purchases in any one fiscal year of 3,000 shares.
